title: Stephen Jones: We haven't gotten to point where we can agree on Brandon Aubrey extension

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Stephen Jones: We haven't gotten to point where we can agree on Brandon Aubrey extension
sources.description: The Cowboys agreed to a new contract with running back Javonte Williams over the weekend and they are poised to use the franchise tag on wide receiver George Pickens, but those aren't the only pieces of business they are contending with ahead of the new league year.
